blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在大视野语言模型(LVLMs)中,迷幻仍然是一个重大挑战. 现有的无训练方法一般通过对比解码或视觉增强来缓解幻觉,往往会增加视觉证据在生成过程中的相对影响. 这提出了一个根本性的问题: LVLMs能动态调节不同上下文源对抑制幻觉的贡献吗? 在这项工作中,我们调查并量化LVLMs在解码过程中如何协调多个上下文源,并研究这种内在行为如何指导幻觉的缓解. 我们发现,LVLM表现出一种内在的视觉导向趋势,可以指导适应性的视觉引导,而文字背景也可以有助于缓解幻觉。 基于这些发现,我们提出AIMS(动态信息多源引导),这是一个轻量级的无培训框架,在解码过程中适应性地协调视觉,预填文本和生成的环境. 具体而言,AIMS为三个上下文域构建了紧凑的原型,并估算它们与当前查询的亲和性,以确定头部方向轴重. 由此产生的多源指导方向适用于查询表示方式,从而能够在不增加模型培训或辅助前传通行证的情况下进行适应性上下文整合。 跨越多个LVLM和解码策略的广泛实验表明,AIMS有效缓解物体幻觉,同时保持具有竞争力的通用多式联运能力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) [ 4 , 21 , 25 , 40 , 38 , 39 ] have enabled remarkable progress in bridging visual perception and language reasoning. By integrating powerful vision encoders with large language models (LLMs), LVLMs demonstrate strong capabilities in tasks such as image understanding [ 18 ] , visual question answering [ 16 , 30 ] , and multimodal reasoning [ 8 , 31 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 近期在大视野语言模型(LVLMs)[4, 21, 25, 40, 38, 39] 上的进展使得在弥合视觉感知和语言推理方面取得了显著进展. 通过将强大的视觉编码器与大语言模型(LLMs)相融合,LVLMs在图像理解[18],视觉问题回答[16,30],多模式推理[8,31,34]等任务上表现出了强大的能力.

blocks.en: Despite their remarkable capabilities, LVLMs still suffer from hallucination [ 20 , 7 ] , generating content inconsistent with visual inputs, such as non-existent objects, incorrect attributes, or erroneous relationships. Unlike hallucination in text-only LLMs [ 27 , 11 ] , LVLM hallucination is inherently tied to the interaction between visual evidence and language generation, posing a critical challenge to model reliability.
blocks.zh: LVLM尽管能力出众,但仍有幻觉[20,7],生成的内容与视觉输入不一致,如不存在对象,不正确的属性,或错误的关系. 与仅文本LLMS [27, 11]中的幻觉不同,LVLM幻觉与视觉证据和语言生成之间的相互作用有着内在的联系,对模型可靠性提出了关键的挑战.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 1 , existing training-free methods mainly mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding [ 17 , 33 , 13 ] or visual enhancement [ 24 , 14 , 41 ] . However, they largely overlook the dynamic utilization of contextual information during generation and focus predominantly on visual evidence, leaving textual prompts and generation history underexplored. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate different context sources to suppress hallucinations?
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,现有的无培训方法主要通过对比解码[17、33、13]或视觉增强[24、14、41]来缓解幻觉。 然而,它们在很大程度上忽略了在生成过程中动态利用背景信息的问题,主要侧重于视觉证据,使文字提示和生成历史没有得到充分利用。 这就提出了一个根本性的问题: LVLMs能否动态地调节不同上下文源来抑制幻觉?.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison of training-free hallucination mitigation methods for LVLMs. From left to right: contrastive decoding, visual enhancement, and our method that dynamically steers the query toward three context branches during generation.
blocks.zh: 图1:LVLMs无培训幻觉缓解方法比较. 从左到右:对比解码,视觉增强, 和我们的方法 动态引导查询 向三个上下文分支的生成。

blocks.en: To better explore this issue, we design a series of preliminary experiments to quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during autoregressive generation and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. Our analysis yields three observations. First, LVLMs exhibit a stage-dependent vision-attending tendency, with visual attention peaking during object grounding and decreasing as generation shifts toward semantic summarization. Second, directly exploiting this intrinsic tendency through query-adaptive steering mitigates hallucination more effectively than uniformly amplifying visual information. Third, prefilled text and generation history also provide corrective signals beyond visual evidence. Together, these findings highlight the need to adaptively coordinate multiple context sources rather than uniformly enhancing visual information.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地探索这一问题,我们设计了一系列初步实验,以量化LVLMs如何在自递回生成过程中协调多个上下文源,并研究这种内在行为如何能指导幻觉的缓解. 我们的分析得出了三种看法。 首先, LVLMs 呈现出一种依赖相位的视觉观察趋势,在物体搁浅时视觉注意力会达到顶峰并随着一代人向语义概括转变而减少. 第二,直接利用这种内在趋势,通过查询调整引导,比统一扩展视觉信息更有效地减轻幻觉。 第三,预填文本和生成历史也提供了超越视觉证据的纠正信号. 这些调查结果共同突出表明,必须适应性地协调多种背景来源,而不是统一加强视觉信息。

blocks.en: Building on these observations, we propose A daptive I nformation M ulti-source S teering (AIMS), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual context ( V V ), prefilled text context ( P P ), and previously generated context ( G G ). Specifically, AIMS constructs semantic prototypes for the three contextual sources and estimates their query-dependent affinities at each decoding step. The affinity-weighted prototypes are aggregated to steer the current query representation, enabling dynamic multi-source coordination according to the generation state. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of AIMS, achieving up to a 27.1% relative reduction in CHAIR C S C_{S} across different LVLMs and decoding strategies, while preserving general multimodal capabilities. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 根据这些观察,我们提议采用Daptive I nform M ulti-source S Teering(AIMS),这是适应性地协调视觉环境(V V),预填文本上下文(P P),以及以前产生的上下文(G G. 具体而言,AIMS为三个上下文源构建语义原型,并估计它们在每个解码步骤上依赖查询的亲和性. 亲和加权原型被汇总,以引导当前查询表示,使得能根据生成状态进行动态多源协调. 对四项基准的广泛试验表明AIMS的有效性,在保持一般多式能力的同时,在LVLM和解码战略方面,CS CQQS}的相对减少达到27.1%。 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We investigate the contextual utilization behavior of LVLMs during autoregressive generation and reveal that visual reliance dynamically changes across generation stages. Our analysis further shows that hallucination mitigation requires considering multiple contextual sources beyond visual information alone. • We propose Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering (AIMS), a training-free framework that dynamically coordinates vision, prefilled text, and generated contexts through query-context affinity. Unlike existing methods that rely on fixed amplification of a single information source, AIMS adaptively integrates evidence during generation. • We conduct extensive experiments on multiple representative LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Qwen3.5, across four widely used benchmarks. The results demonstrate that AIMS consistently reduces hallucination while effectively preserving overall generation quality compared with existing training-free approaches.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们调查LVLM在自递回生成过程中的背景利用行为,并揭示视觉依赖在生成阶段的动态变化. 我们的分析进一步表明,缓解幻觉需要考虑多种背景来源,而不仅仅是视觉信息。 我们提议采用适应性信息多来源指导(AIMS),这是一个无培训框架,能动态地协调愿景、预填文本和通过查询-文本的亲和性生成背景。 与依靠固定放大单一信息来源的现有方法不同,AIMS在生成过程中适应性地融合了证据. ^ 我们对多种具有代表性的LVLM进行广泛的试验,包括LLaVA-1.5、Quen2.5-VL和Quen3.5,这些试验涉及四个广泛使用的基准。 结果表明,与现有的无培训办法相比,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域始终在减少幻觉,同时有效地保持总体发电质量。

blocks.en: We investigate the contextual utilization behavior of LVLMs during autoregressive generation and reveal that visual reliance dynamically changes across generation stages. Our analysis further shows that hallucination mitigation requires considering multiple contextual sources beyond visual information alone.
blocks.zh: 我们调查LVLM在自递回生成过程中的背景利用行为,并揭示视觉依赖在生成阶段的动态变化. 我们的分析进一步表明,缓解幻觉需要考虑多种背景来源,而不仅仅是视觉信息。

blocks.en: We propose Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering (AIMS), a training-free framework that dynamically coordinates vision, prefilled text, and generated contexts through query-context affinity. Unlike existing methods that rely on fixed amplification of a single information source, AIMS adaptively integrates evidence during generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用适应性信息多来源指导(AIMS),这是一个无培训框架,能动态地协调愿景、预填文本和通过查询-文本的亲和性生成背景。 与依靠固定放大单一信息来源的现有方法不同,AIMS在生成过程中适应性地将证据整合.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on multiple representative LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Qwen3.5, across four widely used benchmarks. The results demonstrate that AIMS consistently reduces hallucination while effectively preserving overall generation quality compared with existing training-free approaches.
blocks.zh: 我们对多种具有代表性的LVLM进行广泛的试验,包括LLaVA-1.5、Quen2.5-VL和Quen3.5,这些试验涉及四个广泛使用的基准。 结果表明,与现有的无培训办法相比,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域始终在减少幻觉,同时有效地保持总体发电质量。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LARGE VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS
blocks.zh: 2.1 目标图像-语言模块

blocks.en: Modern Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have evolved rapidly through the scaling of architectural connections and language backbones. Early paradigms utilized LLaMA [ 28 , 29 ] as the linguistic foundation, employing simple MLPs or Q-Formers to project visual tokens, as exemplified by LLaVA [ 22 , 21 ] and MiniGPT series [ 40 , 3 ] . To handle denser multimodal semantics, subsequent architectures transitioned to highly optimized backbones; the Qwen-VL series [ 1 , 2 ] introduced VIT-perceiver to internalize fine-grained visual features, while the InternLM-XComposer series [ 36 , 37 ] and InternVL [ 6 , 5 ] scaled up the LLM bases and integrated dynamic high-resolution vision-language interaction. Despite their superior multimodal capabilities, contemporary LVLMs still suffer from severe object hallucination problems [ 26 ] . Effectively mitigating these hallucinations during inference remains a critical challenge, motivating our training-free dynamic steering framework.
blocks.zh: 现代大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)通过建筑连接和语言骨干规模的扩大而迅速发展. 早期的范式以LLaMA[28,29]作为语言基础,使用简单的MLPs或Q-Formers来投射视觉符号,例如LLaVA[22,21]和MiniGPT系列[40,3]. 为了处理更密集的多模式语义,后期建筑向高度优化的骨干结构过渡;Quen-VL系列[1,2]引入了VIT-percever,将精致的视觉特性内部化,而InternLM-XComposer系列[36,37]和InternVL[6,5]则扩大了LLM基础并整合了动态高分辨率视觉语言交互. 尽管具有优越的多模式能力,但当代LVLM仍然有严重的物体幻觉问题[26]. 在推论期间有效缓解这些幻觉仍然是一项关键的挑战,它激励着我们的无培训动态指导框架。

blocks.en: 2.2 MITIGATING HALLUCINATIONS IN LVLMS
blocks.zh: 2.2 低脂动物的消毒药

blocks.en: In LVLMs, object hallucination remains the most prevalent form of hallucination, typically manifesting as errors in object category, attribute, and inter-object relation descriptions. To mitigate this issue, existing methods can be broadly divided into several lines. Early studies focused on improving fine-grained vision-language alignment and reducing co-occurrence bias in captioning models [ 26 ] . More recent approaches leverage hallucination-oriented supervision, such as dedicated fine-tuning datasets and RLHF-based optimization [ 10 , 35 ] . Another important direction is training-free inference-time intervention. Attentional intervention methods [ 14 , 24 , 12 ] suppress hallucinations by modifying attention behaviors during decoding, but often incur extra inference overhead. In parallel, contrastive-decoding-based methods, such as SID [ 13 ] and VCD [ 17 ] , steer the decoding distribution by contrasting different visual or textual conditions, though their effectiveness may be unstable due to the additional noise introduced in the contrastive process.
blocks.zh: 在LVLMs中,对象幻觉仍然是最普遍的幻觉形式,典型表现为对象类别,属性,和对象间关系描述中的出错. 为缓解这一问题,现有方法大致可分为几行. 早期研究的重点是改善精细的视觉语言相接性,并减少字幕模型中的共发偏差[26]. 更近期的方法利用了以幻觉为导向的监督,如专用的微调数据集和基于RLHF的优化[10,35]. 另一个重要方向是无培训推断时间干预。 注意力干预方法 [14, 24, 12] 通过在解码时修改注意力行为来抑制幻觉,但经常引起外推性超高. 平行地,基于对比的解码方法,如SID [13]和VCD [17],通过对比不同的视觉或文字条件来引导解码分布,尽管由于对比过程中引入了额外的噪音,其有效性可能不稳定.

blocks.zh: 3 初步研究

blocks.en: We conduct preliminary experiments on the CHAIR benchmark using 500 MSCOCO examples with Qwen2.5-VL-3B. We examine the temporal dynamics of visual attention during generation, compare fixed and query-adaptive visual steering, and investigate the contributions of different context sources to hallucination mitigation. These analyses yield three key observations.

blocks.en:
Observation 1. Vision attention naturally peaks when object grounding is required. To examine how visual reliance evolves throughout generation, we evenly divide the generated sequences into five length bins according to the number of samples and measure the average attention from the query to visual tokens at each generation timestep.
As shown in Fig. 2 , despite substantial differences in sequence length, visual attention consistently peaks around T ​ 1 ∈ { 4 , 5 } T1\in\{4,5\} , when generation moves beyond generic openings (e.g. “ The image depicts a … ”) and begins grounding concrete objects and attributes. It then gradually declines as generation shifts toward summarization and world-knowledge extrapolation at T ​ 2 T2 , where less direct visual evidence is required. This pattern aligns with human intuition: during summarization and extrapolation, generation can rely on previously established context rather than direct visual evidence.

blocks.en: 4 method
blocks.zh: 4 个方法

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of AIMS. Given vision, prefilled text, and generated-token key caches, AIMS constructs head-wise multi-context prototypes and adaptively weights them according to their affinity with the current query. The weighted prototypes form a dynamic steering target that adjusts the query representation before standard self-attention.
blocks.zh: 图3:AIMS概览。 AIMS基于视觉,预填文本,以及生成-token密钥缓存,构建出头向多文本原型,并根据其与当前查询的亲和性进行适应性加权. 加权原型形成动态引导目标,在标准自觉前调整查询表示.

blocks.en: The above observations reveal a phenomenon overlooked by existing methods: LVLMs inherently exhibit a semantically meaningful vision-attending tendency aligned with their evolving generation needs, suggesting that hallucination mitigation can benefit from reinforcing, rather than overriding, this intrinsic tendency. Moreover, enhancing prefilled and generated contexts can also mitigate hallucinations, indicating that useful corrective signals extend beyond visual evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS ( A daptive I nformation M ulti-source S teering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates three context sources inherent to autoregressive generation: vision tokens ( V V ) for perceptual evidence, prefilled text tokens ( P P ) for task intent, and previously generated tokens ( G G ) for contextual coherence. By estimating their query-dependent affinities, AIMS dynamically determines which contextual information should guide each decoding step, rather than relying on fixed or vision-centric steering.
blocks.zh: 上述观察揭示出一种被现有方法所忽略的现象: LVLMs本身就显示出一种与其不断变化的一代需要相适应的、有目的的视觉趋势,这表明从加强而不是压倒性地加强这一内在趋势中可以减少幻觉。 此外,增强预填和生成的环境也可以缓解幻觉,表明有用的纠正信号超越了视觉证据. 基于这些结论,我们提议AIMS(一个Daptive I nform Multi-source Steering),一个轻量级的无培训框架,适应性地协调自递性生成所固有的三个上下文源:视觉符号(V V)用于知觉证据,预填文本符号(P P)用于任务意图,以及以前产生的符号(G G G)用于背景一致性. AIMS通过估计其依赖查询的亲和性,动态地确定哪些背景信息应当指导每个解码步骤,而不是依赖固定或以视觉为中心的引导.

blocks.en: In Transformer attention, the relevance of contextual information to the current generation state is naturally captured through query–key matching. We therefore leverage the existing key cache to construct compact prototypes for each context source. Specifically, we identify vision tokens ( V V ), prefilled text tokens ( P P ), and previously generated tokens ( G G ) by their token indices and mean-pool their key representations within each source. For attention head h h , the prototype of context source i i is defined as 𝐩 i h = 1 N i ​ ∑ j = 1 N i 𝐤 i , j h , i ∈ { V , P , G } , \mathbf{p}_{i}^{h}=\frac{1}{N_{i}}\sum_{j=1}^{N_{i}}\mathbf{k}_{i,j}^{h},\qquad i\in\{V,P,G\}, (1) where 𝐤 i , j h \mathbf{k}_{i,j}^{h} denotes the key representation of the j j -th token in context source i i , and N i N_{i} is the number of tokens in that source. The resulting prototypes 𝐩 V h \mathbf{p}_{V}^{h} , 𝐩 P h \mathbf{p}_{P}^{h} , and 𝐩 G h \mathbf{p}_{G}^{h} provide compact summaries of the three context sources in the model’s native query–key representation space, allowing their relevance to the current query to be measured in a unified manner. Since the prototypes are constructed directly from the existing key cache, this process requires no additional encoding or auxiliary forward passes and introduces only lightweight computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 在"变形器"关注中,背景信息与当前生成状态的相关性自然通过查询-键匹配来捕捉. 因此,我们利用现有的关键缓存为每个上下文源构建紧凑的原型。 具体地说,我们通过符号指数确定视觉符号(V V),预填文本符号(P P),以及以前生成的符号(G G),并在每个来源内平均汇集关键表述。 对于注意头h h,上下文源i的原型被定义为:pi h = 1 N i = j = 1 ni ki, j h, i {v, P, G },\ mathbf{p}_{i}^{h}=\frac{1}{N_{i}}\sum_{j=1}^{i_{i}}\mathhfi,j}^{h},\qquad i\ in\ v, P, G\\\ (1) 其中 k i, j h\ mathbf{ k\\i, j\ h} 表示上下文源 i 中的 j - 第 j - sord 的关键代表, 而 N i N\\\i} 是该源中的 orders 数 。 由此形成的原型为p V h\ mathbf{p}_{V}^{h},p h\ mathbf{p}_{P}^{h},和p G h\ mathbf{p}_{G}^{h},提供了模型本地查询-键表示空间中三个上下文源的紧凑摘要,使其与当前查询的相关性能够被统一地测量. 由于原型是直接从现有的密钥缓存中构建的,这个过程不需要额外的编码或辅助前行通行证,而只引入了轻量级计算高通.

blocks.en: Observation 2 suggests that effective intervention should follow, rather than override, the model’s intrinsic information-attending tendency. Since the current query encodes the generation state at timestep t t , its compatibility with different context prototypes provides a natural internal signal of which information sources are currently relevant. We therefore use query–context affinity to adaptively determine the contribution of each context source.
blocks.zh: 意见2表明,有效的干预应当遵循而不是压倒模型固有的信息意图趋势。 由于目前的查询在时间stept t t 中编码了生成状态,它与不同上下文原型的相容性提供了一个天然的内部信号,目前该信息源与此相关. 因此,我们使用查询-文本亲和性来适应性地确定每个上下文来源的贡献。

blocks.en: Specifically, for context source c ∈ { V , P , G } c\in\{V,P,G\} and attention head h h , we measure the affinity between the current query 𝐪 t h \mathbf{q}_{t}^{h} and the corresponding prototype 𝐩 c , t h \mathbf{p}_{c,t}^{h} using cosine similarity and map it to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Consequently, the resulting weights are simultaneously source-, head-, and timestep-adaptive, allowing AIMS to capture fine-grained variations in contextual demand throughout autoregressive generation.

blocks.en: For notational simplicity, we use 𝐩 c , t h \mathbf{p}_{c,t}^{h} to denote the prototype available at timestep t t . The visual and prefilled contexts remain unchanged during decoding, and thus 𝐩 V , t h = 𝐩 V h \mathbf{p}_{V,t}^{h}=\mathbf{p}_{V}^{h} and 𝐩 P , t h = 𝐩 P h \mathbf{p}_{P,t}^{h}=\mathbf{p}_{P}^{h} are fixed. In contrast, the generated context grows autoregressively. Instead of repeatedly pooling an increasingly long generation history, we use the key representation of the latest generated token as 𝐩 G , t h \mathbf{p}_{G,t}^{h} . As this representation has already contextualized the preceding tokens through causal self-attention, it provides a naturally updated and lightweight summary of the generation history.

blocks.en: 5.1 EXPERIMENTAL SETTINGS
blocks.zh: 5.1 警告设置

blocks.en:
Models and Baselines. We evaluate AIMS on three representative LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 21 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-3B [ 2 ] , and Qwen3.5-9B.
Since AIMS is a training-free framework, we compare it with representative hallucination mitigation methods, including VCD [ 17 ] , SID [ 13 ] , VTI [ 23 ] , OPERA [ 12 ] , MemVR [ 41 ] and Baseline.
blocks.zh:
模型和基线。 我们对大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海三个具有代表性的LVLM进行评估,包括LLaVA-1.5-7B[21]、Quen2.5-VL-3B[2]和Quen3.5-9B。
由于大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域是一个无培训的框架,我们把它与有代表性的幻觉减缓方法进行比较,包括VCD [17]、SID [13]、VTI [23]、OPERA [12]、MemVR [41]和基线。

blocks.en: For decoding strategies, we evaluate AIMS under three generation settings: greedy decoding, beam search with 5 beams, and nucleus sampling with temperature=1, top-p=0.9, and top-k=50. For comparison methods, we follow the decoding strategies supported in their original papers.
blocks.zh: 对于解码策略,我们在三代设置下评价AIMS:贪取解码,取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 为了比较方法,我们遵循他们原始文件中支持的解码战略。

blocks.en: Datasets. CHAIR [ 26 ] evaluates object hallucination in image captioning. Following previous works, we randomly sample 500 MSCOCO [ 19 ] images and report CHAIR I \mathrm{CHAIR}_{I} ( C I C_{I} ), CHAIR S \mathrm{CHAIR}_{S} ( C S C_{S} ), Recall ( R R ), F1, and generation length ( L ​ e ​ n Len ). AMBER-G [ 32 ] evaluates object, attribute, and relation hallucinations in free-form descriptions. We follow the official protocol and report C ​ H ​ A ​ I ​ R CHAIR , C ​ o ​ v ​ e ​ r Cover , H ​ a ​ l Hal , and C ​ o ​ g Cog . FaithScore [ 15 ] evaluates free-form hallucinations through atomic-fact verification. We evaluate on LLaVA-1k and report FaithScore and Sentence-FaithScore. MME [ 9 ] evaluates perception and cognition across 14 subtasks. We report perception ( P ​ e ​ r Per ), cognition ( C ​ o ​ g Cog ), and total ( S ​ u ​ m Sum ) scores.

AMBER-G [32] 在自由形式描述中评价对象,属性,以及关系幻觉. 我们遵循官方协议, FaithScore [15]通过原子-事实验证来评价自由形式的幻觉. 我们评价LLaVA-1k,并报告FaithScore和Pried-FaithScore。 MME [9]评价14个子任务的感知和认知. 我们报告感知(P e r Per),认知(C o g Cog),以及总分(S u m Sum).

blocks.en: 5.2 EXPERIMENTAL RESULTS
blocks.zh: 5.2 警告性结果

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , AIMS achieves the lowest C S C_{S} in all nine model-decoding settings, consistently outperforming the baseline and existing training-free methods. Notably, AIMS maintains a consistent advantage over VTI across all three LVLMs and decoding strategies. While VTI applies pre-computed intervention directions consistently across queries, AIMS adapts its steering to the current generation state. This query-dependent coordination may explain its stable advantage across different decoding dynamics. Compared with contrastive decoding methods such as VCD and SID, AIMS also achieves stronger hallucination reduction without constructing additional contrastive inputs or auxiliary forward passes.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域在所有9个模型解码设置中都实现了最低的C S CQQS},持续地超过了基线和现有的无培训方法。 值得注意的是,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海在所有3个LVLM和解码战略中都比VTI具有一贯优势。 虽然VTI在各种查询中始终采用预先计算过的干预指示,但AIMS将其指导调整为当前生成状态。 这种依赖查询的协调可以解释它在不同解码动态中的稳定优势. 相较于VCD和SID等对比性解码方法,AIMS还实现了更强的幻觉减少而无需构建额外的对比性输入或辅助前行通道.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , AIMS consistently achieves lower H ​ a ​ l Hal than VTI across all six model-decoding settings, indicating fewer hallucinated responses, while maintaining comparable C ​ o ​ v ​ e ​ r Cover scores and thus similar object coverage. This suggests that its hallucination reduction does not simply result from mentioning fewer objects present in the image. Beyond this general trend, AIMS also reduces C ​ o ​ g Cog across all decoding strategies on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, indicating a lower tendency to generate the human-cognition-associated hallucinated objects captured by AMBER. Together with the consistently lower C ​ H ​ A ​ I ​ R CHAIR scores, these results show that AIMS improves hallucination control at both the object and response levels without a substantial coverage trade-off.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域在所有六个模型解码设置中始终达到低于VTI的H a Hal,表明幻觉反应较少,同时保持可比的C o v e Cover分数,从而达到类似的对象覆盖。 这表明其幻觉的还原并不仅仅是因为提到图像中存在的物体较少. 除了这一总的趋势外,AIMS还减少了所有在Quen2.5-VL-3B上解码策略的Co克克,表明生成AMBER所捕获的与人认知相联的幻觉物体的倾向更低. 这些结果加上C H A I R CHAIR 的分数一直较低,表明AIMS在物体和反应两级都改进了幻觉控制,而没有大幅度的覆盖取舍。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 , AIMS achieves the highest FS and S-FS across all three decoding strategies, with particularly pronounced sentence-level gains under beam search and nucleus sampling. Unlike object-centric metrics, FaithScore evaluates descriptive content by decomposing it into atomic facts and verifying their consistency with the image. The improvements therefore provide complementary evidence that AIMS extends beyond reducing hallucinated objects to improving the faithfulness of fine-grained visual facts in free-form responses.
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域在所有三个解码战略中实现了最高的FS和S-FS,在光束搜索和核取样下取得了特别显著的句子级收益。 与以对象为中心的度量衡不同,FaithScore通过将内容分解为原子事实并验证其与图像的一致性来评价描述性内容. 因此,这些改进提供了补充证据,表明AIMS超越了减少幻觉对象,而提高了自由形式反应中精细视觉事实的忠实性.

blocks.en: Together with Tables 2 – 4 , Table 5 shows that AIMS largely preserves the general-purpose multimodal capabilities of the original models while substantially reducing hallucinations. VTI achieves effective hallucination mitigation but exhibits noticeable MME degradation on the two Qwen models, whereas MemVR better preserves general capabilities but provides more limited hallucination reduction. Overall, AIMS achieves a better balance between hallucination mitigation and general-purpose capability preservation.
blocks.zh: 与表2-表4一起,表5显示AIMS在很大程度上保留了原型的通用多式能力,并大大减少了幻觉. VTI能够有效缓解幻觉,但在两个Quen模型上显示出明显的MME退化,而MemVR则能更好地保持一般能力,但能提供更有限的幻觉减少. 总体而言,AIMS在缓解幻觉和普通用途能力保存之间实现了更好的平衡.

blocks.en: Temporal Adaptivity of Steering Weights. We measure the temporal variability of steering weights using their standard deviation across decoding timesteps. As shown in Figure 6 , the three branches exhibit distinct layer- and head-specific patterns. For V V , large variations are sparsely concentrated in individual heads at earlier layers (e.g., Layers 4, 13, and 19), but become broadly distributed across heads in Layers 31–33. P P shows more dispersed variations across middle and deep layers, whereas G G exhibits stronger layer-wise structures around Layers 20, 27, and 31–33. These distinct patterns suggest different dynamic utilization of contextual sources during decoding, motivating fine-grained affinity-adaptive multi-source steering across timesteps.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we revisit object hallucination in LVLMs from the perspective of multi-context interaction. Our analysis systematically reveals an intrinsic vision-attending tendency during generation and shows that complementary contextual information beyond visual evidence can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS, a training-free method that constructs compact context prototypes and dynamically coordinates their contributions during decoding. Extensive experiments across different LVLM architectures and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS consistently reduces object hallucination while preserving strong general-purpose multimodal capabilities. We hope our findings encourage a shift from visual-centric intervention toward adaptive multi-context coordination for hallucination mitigation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们从多文本交互的角度重新审视LVLMs中的对象幻觉. 我们的分析系统地揭示了一代人中内在的视觉感想趋势,并表明,视觉证据以外的补充性背景信息也有助于缓解幻觉。 基于这些调查结果,我们提议大西洋、印度洋、地中海和南海区域采用无培训方法,构建紧凑的上下文原型,并在解码过程中积极协调它们的贡献。 跨越不同LVLM架构的广泛实验和编解码策略表明,AIMS在保持强大的通用多模式能力的同时,不断减少物体幻觉. 我们希望我们的调查结果鼓励从以视觉为中心的干预转向适应性的多文字协调,以缓解幻觉。
